hypothesis: Heat denaturation of DNA creates a requirement for heat-stable DNA polymerase to enable repeated primer extension cycles
prediction: The efficiency of DNA amplification will increase when heat-stable DNA polymerase is used compared to heat-labile DNA polymerase
measurement_method: Compare the amount of extended DNA product after multiple heating/cooling cycles using heat-stable versus heat-labile DNA polymerase
falsification_condition: Heat-stable DNA polymerase produces less than 1.5 times more DNA product than heat-labile DNA polymerase after multiple thermal cycles
